governed_construct: A function body with a block: the source lines strictly between the opening '{' and closing '}' of any function declaration, function expression, generator, arrow function with a block body, class method, constructor, getter/setter, or object method. Concise-body arrow functions with no braces and empty bodies contribute no interior lines but still count as instances.
interpretation: The rule forbids empty (whitespace-only) source lines inside a function body. A unit is VIOLATED if any function body (including nested functions/callbacks, and including lines inside nested blocks or object literals within the body) contains a whitespace-only line of source layout. Blank lines between top-level statements, between class members, inside interfaces, type declarations, or top-level object literals are outside any function and are allowed. Comment lines are not blank. Newlines that are part of a string or template-literal value are string content, not source layout, so an empty line inside a multi-line template literal does not violate the rule. A file with no functions at all is NOT_APPLICABLE; a file with at least one function and no blank lines inside any function body is SATISFIED.
